title: Freelancing in New York, Wynton Kelly at Mikell's and Toronto
summary: Back in New York Sam plays duo with Wynton Kelly at Mikell's and encourages him to take a Toronto job.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Through with it, and then started freelancing around New York then man, uhm, getting myself together in the-start, working in little clubs and different little places around New York. Started making a record here and a record there you know, uhm, then uhm, the association with Wynton Kelly, started playing a duo at Mikell's first place up on 95th Street.
He got a nice little room in there You remember that place?
And uh, me and Jimmy Cobb, right.

Used to play in there, and then uh, we used to play around town, different little gigs and stuff around town, and uhm, that's when we lost, he went to Canada. I was supposed to go with him, but Wynton wasn't feeling so good and I encouraged him to go up there. I said maybe you should get out of town you know, uhm, to a different atmosphere man, you feel better. You know because Wynton wanted to go up there and play with him because they was gonna, it was a sad drummer up there that we would have to cope with, play with you know.
This guy wasn't going to let you bring the drums with you.
He wanted to play with you. He was the guy who owned the club.

And I couldn't see that, man, for no three weeks man, so they won't have me playing with this dude man, I say Jesus Christ. So I told Wynton why don't you go on, go on up there and the money's good and I said you, the accompaniment they got him just for the good bass player, up in Toronto, and that's when he cut out in Toronto, so after that then my association with Cedar, Cedar Walton.
